name: Regressor
source:
After losing his businessman father and having all his inheritance stolen by his stepmother, the protagonist gains the power of a demon—a time-rewinding ability—just before giving up on everything. Using this newfound ability, he begins to live guided purely by his desires...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/title-regressor-112803942]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在失去了商人父亲并被继母夺走所有遗产后，主人公在放弃一切之前获得了恶魔之力——一种时光倒流的能力。利用这种新发现的能力，他开始纯粹按照自己的欲望生活……

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/title-regressor-112803942]Patreon[/url]]
